why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Set up a DeFi wallet Install a wallet such as MetaMask or Trust Wallet, which Kinza's FAQ names for connecting to its app. Fund it with an asset the app supports on BNB Chain, opBNB, Ethereum or Mantle.
2 Step 2 : Connect the wallet to the Kinza app Open the Kinza app and click Connect Wallet. The dashboard then lists the assets you can supply.
3 Step 3 : Supply a supported asset Deposit an asset into one of the lending markets. Each transaction carries a network gas fee that the app shows before you approve it.

4 Step 4 : Leave the deposit in place Points grow with the value and the time of the deposit, so a larger or longer deposit earns more. If you already had a deposit when Season 2 began, points started accruing without any extra action.
5 Step 5 : Check your points on the dashboard In the Kinza app , click the Airdrop button beside your wallet address to see your points and your referral tools.
